leah: AuroraSpark joint bench kickoff — partner wants compact perf/W recipe and kernel tuning checklist. @diego @tom please propose minimal sweep.
diego: Minimal: model=llama-13b, seq=1024/2048, power=120/160W, quants=q4_0,q8_0. Metrics: p50/p95/p99, throughput_tps, avg_power_w@5Hz.
tom: Lab slot Mon 10-12 PT. Kernel flags: isolcpus=2-7 nohz_full=2-7 rcu_nocbs=2-7. Will verify firmware version.
leah: Acceptance criteria: perf/W >= +9% at 120W OR p99 < 260ms at seq=2048. Partner wants CSV and one-pager for marketplace listing.
diego: Will draft runbook, CSV schema, and run script. Output path s3://redwood-bench/aurora/1789999001/.
bench-bot: JIRA INF-9456 created, label=aurora-spark. Tag experiments with "aurora-2026-q1".
leah: Action items: Diego -> run scripts + CSV; Tom -> rack prep + power meter cal; I'll draft partner one-pager and schedule Wed 9am PT sync if smoke passes.
diego: Ack. Doing smoke tonight and will upload artifacts.
tom: Ack. Preparing bench and validating NVML/PMU capture.
leah: :thumbsup: Thanks team. Looping partner after smoke.
